# owner: platform
import unittest
from rosterkit.seating import seating_rows
from rosterkit.models import Student


def _pupil(last, first):
    return Student("0000", last, first, "A")


class SeatingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.pupils = [
            _pupil("Halloway", "Juno"),
            _pupil("Thistle", "Bram"),
            _pupil("Dunmere", "Piet"),
        ]

    # ---
    def test_sorted_and_split_into_rows(self):
        lines = seating_rows(self.pupils, 2)
        self.assertEqual(lines, [
            "Row 1: Dunmere, Piet | Halloway, Juno",
            "Row 2: Thistle, Bram",
        ])

    # ---
    def test_single_long_row(self):
        lines = seating_rows(self.pupils, 10)
        self.assertEqual(len(lines), 1)
        self.assertTrue(lines[0].startswith("Row 1: Dun"))

    # ---
    def test_first_name_breaks_ties(self):
        twins = [_pupil("Lee", "Zed"), _pupil("Lee", "Amy")]
        self.assertEqual(
            seating_rows(twins, 2),
            ["Row 1: Lee, Amy | Lee, Zed"],
        )

    # ---
    def test_zero_seats(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            seating_rows(self.pupils, 0)

    # ---
    def test_negative_seats(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            seating_rows(self.pupils, -3)

    # ---
    def test_no_students(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            seating_rows([], 4)
